{{dablink|For the first book in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series by the same name, see ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.}}

The '''Eye of the World''' is an oval-shaped artificial pool located inside a hill in the [[Blight]]. It was created by a hundred male and female [[Aes Sedai]] after the [[Dark One]] tainted ''[[saidin]]''. They worked together using both ''saidin'' and ''[[saidar]]'' to fill it with the essence of cleansed, pure saidin, enough to mend the seal on the Dark One's prison or break it open completely. Knowing that they will die during the process, they asked [[Someshta]], the last living Nym, to guard it. Moiraine explains that many in Tar Valon have attempted to find a way to use the Power in the Eye, but they failed as it is untouchable for any woman.{{ref/book|1|50}} 

==Finding the Eye==
The Eye was a place of legend, and a frequent target of thrillseekers; myth and rumor stated that it could not be found twice, although Moiraine hoped to do so, stating that "Need is the key, and intention". She hoped that her great need, and the presence of three ''ta'veren'', would help her find it a second time.{{ref/book|1|46}} 

Loial later tells Egwene that no two among the Ogier have found it in exactly the same place but it has always been beyond the high passes. Despite that, their group find it before they could reach the high passes. In response, the Green Man says "This place is always where it is. All that changes is where those who need it are." He also gives some more concrete confirmation to the legends, stating that "When [The Eye] was made, it was made so that none could find it twice."{{ref/book|1|49}}

Someshta expresses surprise at meeting Moiraine again, possibly proving that her own theory was correct. Indeed, she is the only known person to have been able to enter the Eye of the World a second time.

When it is discovered that the Eye also had The Horn of Valere, the banner of the Dragon and broken pieces of one of the seven Cuendillar seals of the Dark One's prison, Moirane questions herself: {{quote|The Eye of the World was made against the greatest need the world would ever face, but was it made for the use to which ... we ... put it, or to guard these things?{{ref/book|1|52}}}}

==Confrontation at the Eye==
The Eye houses a [[Well|pool]] of pure, untainted ''saidin ''(acting as a well), [[Lews Therin Telamon]]'s [[Dragon Banner]] and the [[Horn of Valere]]. They also recover one of the [[seven Seals]], but it has already been broken. Moiraine Damodred takes [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Matrim Cauthon]], and [[Perrin Aybara]] there hoping that having the three ''ta'veren'' at the Eye, the Pattern would weave itself around them and "might even weave the Father of Lies into itself, and make him harmless again." However two of the [[Forsaken]] show up as well, [[Aginor]] and [[Balthamel]] apparently having followed them using Mat as a guide. A battle ensues in which Moiraine, [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], and [[Egwene al'Vere]] are all hurt.

It is during this battle with [[Aginor]] and [[Balthamel]] at the Eye that Rand channels consciously for the first time. During the battle, Aginor draws too much ''saidin'' from the Eye and burns himself out, leaving only ashes. Balthamel is killed by [[Someshta]] and the last Nym dies by the effort. With his last spark of life [[Someshta]] gently cups an acorn and an oak grows until it looks five hundred years old to spot the tomb of a legend. The Eye's location quickly deteriorates, but before they leave Loial says ''"It is not right that Treebrother should fall to the Blight."'' So he sings to the oak creating some protection around it. {{quote|This little space, at least, will not sink into the Blight. The Blight will not have Treebrother.{{ref/book|1|53}}}} – he states. The current status of the Eye is unknown, having served its fated purpose.
